description: Products on the brand's WooCommerce store. action list (status, query, sku, categoryId, page), get (id: variations, options, images), create (title, description, shortDescription, sku, tags, categoryIds, status draft (default) | publish, price + compareAtPrice (or regularPrice / salePrice), options [{name, values}] with variants [{price, compareAtPrice, sku, options [{name, value}]}], images [{url, alt}]), update (those fields; a simple product's price), duplicate (id, newTitle: always a draft), set_status (id or ids, status publish | draft | pending | private), delete (id or ids: to the trash; permanent:true for good), tags (ids, addTags, removeTags), add_variants / update_variants (variants with id) / delete_variants (variantIds), add_options (options) / delete_options (names), add_images / remove_images / reorder_images (imageIds in the new order, first = main image), meta (id; set {key: value}, delete [keys]; neither = list), store (the shop's own settings). Publishing, unpublishing, deleting, a live price change and removing variants, options or images are previews until confirm:true. Free.
